name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Twinsburg Sales & Distribution Center, OH

fieldNotes.facility: Coca-Cola Consolidated Twinsburg facility. The roster lists it as a 'Sales / Distribution Center' at 8909 Twin Hills Pkwy - that address is WRONG. Web research establishes the actual facility as Coca-Cola Consolidated's Twinsburg MANUFACTURING / bottling plant at 1882 E Highland Rd, Twinsburg OH 44087 - a 300,000+ sq ft plant operating since 1974, producing 31M+ cases/year; $35M new can-line investment announced Oct 2025; ~260 employees; also home to Red Classic Transit. (Note: the company's separate storage warehouse is in Macedonia ~2 miles away.) Resolved coordinates via OSM geocode of 1882 Highland Rd (41.2977,-81.4538) then satellite identification.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Roster type 'Sales / Distribution Center' is inaccurate - this is a manufacturing/bottling plant with heavy truck staging. JSON keeps the roster name/type for tracking but the dossier documents the correction.
fieldNotes.confirmation: Positively confirmed: 'Coca-Cola' branding clearly visible on the building wall in Street View (2023-07).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance off E Highland Rd shows a defined truck driveway with yellow lane-control bollards and a perimeter chain-link fence with a gated opening. Classified truckGate true (fenced perimeter + controlled gated truck lane). Flagged uncertain - no barrier arm was unambiguously resolved in the imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly staffed guard booth identified at the road entrance; the small structures near the drive read as facility buildings, not a booth. Set false (uncertain).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true - a gated/fenced truck entrance exists but no guard booth, implying kiosk / call-box check-in. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row on the plant's east face with many trailers backed in; estimated ~30-40, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large herringbone trailer drop yards (multiple blocks of trailers); well over 50 - high-throughput plant.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - campus with the main multi-section plant plus a separate large building to the south.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved campus interior provides ample truck stacking.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck driveway and large aprons; room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated on one primary face; set false (could not confirm a separate second dock bank).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Twinsburg is a Cleveland-metro suburb; the site sits in an established industrial park. Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property observed.

citations.claim: $35M in Twinsburg manufacturing facility (1882 Highland Rd), +40 jobs, houses Red Classic Transit

verification.rationale: Active, actively-expanding (Oct 2025) Coca-Cola Consolidated manufacturing + transport hub.
